integrity: The proof uses a cyclic mixed-block determinant, separate C3 matrix, and explicit maximal rank witnesses over all fields. Independent source and finite-dimensional checks are described in the accompanying review.
scientific_limitations: Previously covered K2,2=C4 index is credited; counts distinguish dual functionals, not orbits. Finite checks corroborate but do not prove the universal theorem.
scientific_scope: Gallo–Videla three-step graph Lie algebras of every simple cycle C_n, n≥3, over arbitrary fields; and exact counts of Kirillov forms with radical equal to the center over finite fields.
title: A mod-three and field-size jump in the Kirillov index of cyclic graph Lie algebras
